title: Bug: UT2 golden_config uses stale port_config on deploy-mg
author: conradf-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

For UT2 during deploy-mg when we generate a new golden_config we do not use the port config from the generated minigraph.xml because we do not load the minigraph. This can result in errors where admin_status does not match expected config

Related to:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/24415
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/24157



### Steps to Reproduce

Run deploy-mg on UT2 dut with topology t2_single_node_min or t2_single_node_max
```
./testbed-cli.sh deploy-mg <testbed-name> lab password.txt -vvv
```


### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

After running deploy-mg observe in the log that minigraph is never applied before golden_config_db is generated
```
TASK [saved original minigraph file in SONiC DUT(ignore errors when file does not exist)] ***
...
TASK [create new minigraph file for SONiC device] ******************************
...
TASK [Apply minigraph prior to generating golden_config_db.json] ***************
skipped
...
TASK [Generate golden_config_db.json] ******************************************
...
    "msg": "Success to generate golden_config_db.json for ut2 device"
...
```
Then see after deploy-mg that unexpected ports from old minigraph ports are admin_status up. Also re-running `sudo config load_minigraph` will change the admin_status of these ports back to down.

Note that `generate_ut2_golden_config_db` in generate_golden_config is actually calling `sonic-cfggen -H -m -j /etc/sonic/init_cfg.json --print-data`, but sonic-cfggen does not get port config from the xml, but the running-config:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/202605/src/sonic-config-engine/minigraph.py#L2064
Since the running-config at this moment is not the new generated minigraph, but the original minigraph we get the port config of the older minigraph into the golden config.

Expected that the golden_config_db.json will not have admin_status up on these ports and `sudo config load_minigraph` will be not change admin_status for any ports, because the port_config should be the same

After this change we no longer see stale ports admin_status set to up.
Issue is not observable on 202511, as it does not have this issue until this PR is merged:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/26241 

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
For UT2 config reload needs to run before creating the golden_config to prevent stale port_config being set in golden_config.

This is because `generate_ut2_golden_config_db` in generate_golden_config is actually calling `sonic-cfggen -H -m -j /etc/sonic/init_cfg.json --print-data`, but sonic-cfggen does not get port config from the xml, but the running-config:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/202605/src/sonic-config-engine/minigraph.py#L2064
Since the running-config at this moment is not the new generated minigraph, but the original minigraph we get the port config of the older minigraph into the golden config.

#### How did you do it?
Similar to LT2, let config reload run before generating the golden_config.

comments.body: @conradf-arista QQ - without this change, what is current behavior on master branch with deploy mg? it doesn't load mg? but later load mg from golden mg, would it remain thhe same config db in the end?

comments.author: conradf-arista
comments.body:
> @conradf-arista QQ - without this change, what is current behavior on master branch with deploy mg? it doesn't load mg? but later load mg from golden mg, would it remain thhe same config db in the end?

Without this change config_db and golden_config_db are both set wrong. Specifically some ports will mistakenly have `admin_status: up`

`sudo config load_minigraph` will see these ports go down since minigraph.xml is out of sync with config_db.

After this change config_db and golden_config_db won't have the extra admin_status on the ports.
